column1: # Wailing Caverns (map 43): every hop of the plan's own steps whose way touches water, probed offline on the server's
# ForeverCore v16 mmaps (~/forever-run2/data/mmaps → 0043.mmap + the five 0043_*.mmtile files, the same geometry the route
# walk ran on), 2026-11-21. One line per hop: the destination row (leg, seq, kind) and the walked pair.
# The probe planned every consecutive pair of the generated 302-step plan with forever-agent's ForeverPlanner (the server's
# own navmesh, water allowed), sampled the path vertices and its ground samples every <= 1.5 yd with navmesh.LiquidAt, with
# the run's own point rule (a liquid whose surface is at or above the walked point - 0.6 yd, asked in the point's column),
# and listed the hop when any sample was wet. 21 of 301 hops are wet; every one is shallow (surface 0.0-0.5 yd above the
# walked point), so the run may wade them with ai::kPlanFlagWadeOk. The generator (forever/tools/wc_plan_rows.py) sets that
# flag only on the rows listed here, and only when the row's own hop still matches this pair.
